games.summary: Fremantle are overwhelming favourites in the Western Derby, with all 28 Squiggle models agreeing (FRE by 39.0 weighted consensus). FRE dominate every key stat — contested possessions (+28pt differential), metres gained (+1,034 per game), clearances, and hitouts. Luke Jackson (SC 122.8 avg) wins the ruck battle decisively against a WCE side with hitout diff -15.2. FRE's ODELO at Perth Stadium is an extraordinary net +23.8 as an away team, and they've won three straight at Optus Stadium. WCE's attack is trending down and their defence has conceded 120pts per game average. A dominant FRE victory expected.
